content: Validate the actual executable reference from the actual entry. A simulator initialized at the grasp approach omits the physical entry path. Deterministic resampling must be frozen, provenance-labeled and replayed under the original success and contact checks before hardware use. Keep reference actions separate from simulated and measured state.
applicability: Piper right-only connector task; named radians/width commands adapted to existing degree/95mm-normalized controller; no physical calibration claim
count_semantics: One complete native rollout plus one derived adapted-reference replay, correlated and not independent task trials
limitations: Does not establish safe real fixture registration or calibrated contact parameters
